title: LoupixDeck profile submission
description: profile.json next to a .loupixprofile package in profiles/<author>/<id>/. Holds only what the package does not: device, plugins and commands are read from the package's own manifest.

id.description: Stable id, unique across the repository. Must equal the folder name and never change.

author.description: Your GitHub user name. Must equal the parent folder name.

version.description: major.minor.patch. Raise it every time you change the package.

license.description: SPDX identifier. Defaults to CC-BY-4.0 when missing.

platforms.description: Systems the profile is meant for. Leave empty or omit for every platform.
